decision_basis: Thrombin-thrombomodulin complex formation, EPCR-assisted protein-C activation, and endothelial anticoagulant/anti-inflammatory outputs support qualified-high exact receptor-cofactor/proteolytic-complex function; no canonical intracellular kinase-receptor claim is made.

Direct FVIII-LDLR binding and LDLR-dependent hepatic clearance relevance support qualified-high exact scavenging/clearance evidence; LDLR/LRP1 cooperation and FVIII-von Willebrand-factor presentation remain explicit, with no kinase or TF signaling claim.

ILEI/FAM3C rescue and LIFR perturbation with STAT3-dependent EMT, mammosphere, invasion, and tumor-initiation outputs support qualified-high exact relay/function evidence in mammary and breast-cancer models; gp130-associated architecture remains qualified and STAT3 is provisional.
